methodology: All HS4 and HS6 codes reported in full national export CSVs; no curated-prefix filter. Latest month at 60-month high (ties included), or latest 3-month average >=95% of highest 3-month average wholly within 60 months. Zeros only for absent headings in validated national sources. Codes missing from either HS2017 or HS2022, or with changed official descriptions, excluded. Remaining headings can contain HS revision scope changes; no concordance adjustment. Confidential chapter aggregates excluded.
